findings.current:
Of course, the Slaughter Saint wouldn’t try to silence the witnesses just because Cheongpung told me everything that had happened so far.

Well.
findings.defect: The translation drops the narrator’s explicit thought that, given the situation, it would be polite not to ask any further. The accepted baseline preserves this beat.
findings.rationale: The Korean says, “이 정도면 더 묻지 않는 게 예의다” (“at this point, it’s polite not to ask any further”). This is a distinct pragmatic beat before the narrator admits he is also afraid the Slaughter Saint might really try to silence the witnesses.
findings.replacement:
Of course, the Slaughter Saint wouldn’t try to silence the witnesses just because Cheongpung told me everything that had happened so far.

At this point, it was polite not to ask any further.

Well.

summary: The assembled English is broadly faithful, but it omits a line establishing that asking no further questions is a matter of courtesy.
